Tooltip_LugliDMS_Needs_pry: Needs a crowbar or a pry bar.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Needs_smash: Needs a sledgehammer or an axe.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_MayJam: A failed try can jam the lock
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Spends: A failed try uses up the tool
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Wears: A failed try wears the lockpick down
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Wrecks: Wrecks the box: it can't be carried away after
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Needs_pick: Needs a paperclip or a screwdriver.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Needs_force: Needs a crowbar or a pry bar.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Alarm: A failed try sets off the alarm and locks it
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Burns: Paper, money and food inside may burn
Tooltip_LugliDMS_RightClick: Right-click the box to open it.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_Easing: Easing off, letting the bit cool.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_Near: The seam is close to what is inside.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_CooledSome: The seam has cooled a little.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_DoEase: Keep at it. When the heat reaches red, click Ease off, or the drill overheats and stops.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_DoEasePad: Keep at it. When the heat reaches red, press [%1] to ease off, or the drill overheats and stops.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_DoStop: Near the end, click Stop to let the seam cool, or the torch cuts out.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_DoStopPad: Near the end, press [%1] to let the seam cool, or the torch cuts out.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_Fresh: No input needed. Walk away and this try is lost.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_Kept: No input needed. Walk away any time: the work so far is kept.
Tooltip_LugliDMS_Work_OptionShowTip: A small panel that shows a break-in's work while it runs.
